projects.project_title: Automated Beginner). Data Audit and Diagnostic Tool
projects.problem_statement: Manual validation of dirty production data streams causes silent pipeline degradations.
projects.objective: Build a modular CLI and script that inspects data schema integrity, statistical anomalies, and missing attributes.
projects.dataset_requirement: Kaggle Open Data or synthetic CSV generator
projects.ml_ai_approach: Statistical hypothesis testing and parametric anomaly detection
projects.expected_output: Modular Python library with comprehensive CLI report output
projects.resume_value: Engineered automated data audit pipeline catching schema anomalies with 99% fidelity.

projects.project_title: Predictive Beginner). Intelligence API & Interactive Dashboard
projects.problem_statement: Stakeholders lack immediate predictive insights when querying operational business metrics.
projects.objective: Train a multi-class predictive model, wrap it in a high-throughput REST API, and expose an interactive Plotly dashboard.
features: REST API endpoints with Pydantic validation
Interactive real-time Streamlit UI with Plotly charts
projects.dataset_requirement: UCI Machine Learning Repository or Kaggle Industry Dataset (10k+ rows)
projects.ml_ai_approach: Ensemble Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) with hyperparameter tuning
development_steps: Data cleaning and TF-IDF / one-hot feature encoding
Build Streamlit dashboard for real-time predictions
projects.expected_output: Fully connected web application with sub-50ms inference latency
projects.resume_value: Architected end-to-end ML service with FastAPI & Streamlit serving 100+ requests/sec.

projects.project_title: Enterprise Production Beginner). Platform with Adaptive Learning
projects.problem_statement: Enterprises struggle to monitor, version, and orchestrate ML/AI workflows with containerized reproducibility.
projects.objective: Architect a production-grade microservice incorporating model tracking, automated retraining, and cloud containerization.
features: Automated CI/CD test runner with Pytest
Live model monitoring and drift telemetry
projects.dataset_requirement: Enterprise production logs or Kaggle multi-gigabyte dataset
projects.ml_ai_approach: Deep Neural Network / Hybrid Ensemble with vector embeddings
development_steps: Container architecture design and Dockerfile creation
Pipeline persistence with Joblib and metadata schema
Integration testing suite with 85%+ code coverage
projects.expected_output: Dockerized enterprise application ready for cloud deployment
projects.resume_value: Spearheaded enterprise production platform achieving full test automation and Dockerized deployment.
